Generate a Printable Multi-Page Field Atlas (PDF Map Book)

Source: R/vantor_fieldwork.R
vantor_field_atlas.Rd

Creates a multi-page printable PDF Field Atlas (Map Book) for field supervisors and survey enumerators:

  • Page 1 (Overview Index Map): Displays the full Area of Interest, all Enumeration Area / survey grid boundaries labeled by id_col (e.g., "A1", "A2"), sample points, scale bar, and north arrow.

  • Subsequent Pages (Detail Enumeration Sheets): One page per grid cell or Enumeration Area polygon, zoomed in with a metric margin (buffer_m), optional high-resolution Vantor RGB satellite imagery background, labeled sample points, scale bar, north arrow, and a metadata header/footer with coordinates and imagery vintage.

Usage

vantor_field_atlas(
  grid,
  points = NULL,
  raster = NULL,
  output_file = tempfile(pattern = "vantor_field_atlas_", fileext = ".pdf"),
  id_col = "cell_id",
  point_label_col = "sample_id",
  title = "Vantor Field Enumeration Atlas",
  buffer_m = 50,
  fetch_basemap = FALSE,
  resolution = 0.5,
  product = "VIVID_STANDARD_30",
  paper_width = 11,
  paper_height = 8.5,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

grid

An sf polygon object representing survey grid cells (e.g. from vantor_survey_grid()) or Enumeration Area boundaries.

points

Optional sf point object of sample locations (e.g. from vantor_export_capi()) to plot and label on each map sheet.

raster

Optional terra::SpatRaster or GeoTIFF file path to use as the RGB satellite imagery background.

output_file

Character string. Output PDF file path. Defaults to tempfile(pattern = "vantor_field_atlas_", fileext = ".pdf") in compliance with CRAN policy.

id_col

Character string. Column name in grid used to label each enumeration sheet. Default is "cell_id".

point_label_col

Character string. Optional column name in points used to label sample markers on detail sheets. Default is "sample_id".

title

Character string. Title printed on the overview cover map. Default is "Vantor Field Enumeration Atlas".

buffer_m

Numeric. Buffer distance in meters around each detail cell. Default is 50.

fetch_basemap

Logical. If TRUE and raster is NULL, downloads Vantor WMS satellite imagery for the atlas extent via get_maxar_wms_basemap(). Default is FALSE.

resolution

Numeric. Ground resolution in meters when fetch_basemap = TRUE. Default is 0.5.

product

Character string. Vivid product name when fetch_basemap = TRUE. Default is "VIVID_STANDARD_30".

paper_width

Numeric. PDF page width in inches. Default is 11 (landscape).

paper_height

Numeric. PDF page height in inches. Default is 8.5.

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

Invisibly returns the file path to the generated PDF Field Atlas.

Details

Works both offline (using a pre-downloaded raster SpatRaster or vector-only mode when fetch_basemap = FALSE) and online (fetching Vantor WMS basemap imagery automatically when fetch_basemap = TRUE).

Examples

aoi <- sf::st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -105.01, ymin = 39.73, xmax = -105.00, ymax = 39.74),
  crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
)
grid_sf <- vantor_survey_grid(aoi, cell_size = 600, verbose = FALSE)
pdf_path <- vantor_field_atlas(grid_sf, verbose = FALSE)
unlink(pdf_path)
